Pre-orders for METRO 2039 are now open, and we are revealing the editions that will be available on launch day, come February 4th 2027! 

We know many of you can’t wait to get your hands on the next METRO, and are in desperate need of a wearable Spartan Helmet replica to add to your gaming collection. Well, the day has come to secure it! 

We recently revealed that Blueprints are a new feature in METRO 2039, encouraging exploration and allowing you to craft upgrades and attachments for weapons and gear. There are three upgrades to choose from, but you can only equip one at a time – choose wisely!

Go all-in on All-Out Warfare. 💥

The Battlefield 6 Game of the Year Edition delivers the most complete Battlefield experience.

Fight across land, air, and sea on 20* maps with 70+ weapons, 30+ vehicles, and 700K+ Portal experiences.

Hit the ground running with the Ultimate Shortcut Kit, giving you faster access to fully progressed weapons and attachments across all four classes, plus one season of Battlefield Pro.

The Game of the Year Edition also includes the new Trusted Reserve Pax Support Soldier Skin and the Phantom Pack, featuring four soldier skins, two weapon packages, XP boosts, and more.

*19 maps available at launch. The 20th map is planned to be released on Nov. 10.

#ps5 #ps5games #battlefield6

Experience the thrills and speed of endurance racing in Project Motor Racing. The World Endurance Pack delivers a blend of old and new with 11 cars across 4 endurance classes. The LMP1 class brings back the start of the 2010’s hybrid era with the 2016 Audi R18, Porsche 919 Hybrid and the Toyota TS050 Hybrid. While LMP2 and LMP2 EVO introduce two new classes paying homage to two eras of prototype racing with the 2013 Olivera P2-13 and the 2026 Olivera P2-26 EVO respectively. Then GTP turns back the clocks by bringing six cars from the iconic US racing series with the 1986 BMW March GTP, 1986 Chevrolet Corvette C4 GTP, 1986 Ford Probe GTP, 1988 Jaguar XJR 9 GTP, 1988 Nissan GTP SX-Turbo and the 1988 Porsche 962 GTP.
